popCulture.title: The Birth of Venus
popCulture.creator: Sandro Botticelli
popCulture.description: Botticelli's Zephyrus blows Venus ashore on her shell — the west wind as Renaissance art's most famous breath of spring.

popCulture.title: Zephyr
popCulture.description: English zephyr names a soft breeze — Zephyrus reduced to the everyday word for gentle western air.
